data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'l-b-b' meaning 'love, affection, and deepest feelings'. Labibah is a name of tender emotions and deep love. It is often given to a daughter as a symbol of the mother's love and affection. The name Labibah carries the meaning “Intimate, Love, Affection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Labibah usually hope their child will grow to embody intimate, love, affection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
